description.value: White Sails Brewing is an award-winning craft brewery that has been a fixture of downtown Nanaimo since 2015, located across from Maffeo Sutton Park on the waterfront. The open-concept taproom seats over 100 and pours up to 14 beers alongside guest taps, a selection of wines and ciders, a full coffee bar, and a locally-sourced food menu. Their flagship beers have earned gold medals at the BC Beer Awards, Canadian Brewing Awards, and World Beer Awards.
